pages.text: A block that reads the current collapse phase and estimates how close the next escalation is. It gives no day count.$(br2)Place it in a shelter or workroom.
$(italic)ORSA stopped promising dates when the models started missing reality by the hour.$()

pages.title: Forecast Bands
pages.text: $(bold)Stable:$() holding.$(br)$(bold)Deteriorating:$() sliding.$(br)$(bold)Transition Likely Soon:$() plan for the next phase.$(br)$(bold)Imminent:$() stop pretending you have time.$(br)$(bold)Collapse Underway:$() the final atmospheric failure.

pages.title: Phase 6
pages.text: The barometer tracks each Phase 6 sub-stage:$(li)$(bold)Early:$() extreme blizzard$(li)$(bold)Mid:$() air thins, wind drops, fog lifts$(li)$(bold)Late:$() vacuum$(br2)It warns of whiteout intensification, atmospheric thinning and vacuum onset.
Copper and glass. Damaged weather instrumentation doing its best.
